observations: Black upholstered bed frame with a tufted headboard.
The black fabric covering the slats is severely torn and detached at the headboard end.
Wooden slats are visible through the tear; they appear to be rough-cut timber.
The frame sits low to the ground.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI NWAITE STELLA' is visible on all images.

claims.evidence: The slats are visible but their structural integrity under load cannot be tested remotely.
The item is a bed frame designed for this purpose.

risks.risk: The internal wooden slats may be broken, missing, or poorly spaced under the remaining fabric.
risks.proof: A photo with the black lining fabric completely removed to show all slats.
risks.if_unproven: as needing a full set of new slats

risks.risk: The frame may be wobbly or have damaged joints/brackets.
risks.proof: A video of the frame being shaken firmly at the corners.
risks.if_unproven: as having loose or damaged joints

risks.risk: The exact size (e.g., 4.5ft, 6ft) is unknown, affecting mattress compatibility.
risks.proof: A photo of a measuring tape across the width of the frame.
risks.if_unproven: as the smallest standard double size (4.5ft)

proof_requests: Photo of the bed frame with the black inner fabric fully removed to inspect all slats.
Photo showing the width and length of the frame with a measuring tape.
Video showing the stability of the headboard and frame when pushed.
Close-up photos of the upholstery seams to check for wear or pests.
response.reason: The item is clearly a bed frame. Although the internal fabric is torn and the slats look basic, it can be priced as a used unit in need of minor upholstery repair and potentially new slats.
